findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: connect_account, query_sam_exclusions, query_uk_food_hygiene · Private data: get_usage, request_api_key, claim_api_key, query_uk_planning, query_uk_tenders, query_uk_contract_awards, query_uk_sanctions, query_eu_ted, query_sam_exclusions, query_uk_insolvency, query_uk_companies, query_uk_food_hygiene, query_uk_sponsors, query_uk_charities, query_uk_care_locations, query_uk_schools, query_nhs_ods, query_uk_trademark_journal, query_uk_gambling_operators, query_uk_company_profiles, query_uk_payment_practices, query_uk_company_accounts, query_uk_modern_slavery_statements, query_uk_gender_pay_gap, get_changes · Public sink: connect_account, request_api_key, claim_api_key, query_uk_charities, query_uk_company_profiles, query_uk_payment_practices, query_uk_gender_pay_gap.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: connect_account, query_sam_exclusions, query_uk_food_hygiene · Private data: get_usage, request_api_key, claim_api_key, query_uk_planning, query_uk_tenders, query_uk_contract_awards, query_uk_sanctions, query_eu_ted, query_sam_exclusions, query_uk_insolvency, query_uk_companies, query_uk_food_hygiene, query_uk_sponsors, query_uk_charities, query_uk_care_locations, query_uk_schools, query_nhs_ods, query_uk_trademark_journal, query_uk_gambling_operators, query_uk_company_profiles, query_uk_payment_practices, query_uk_company_accounts, query_uk_modern_slavery_statements, query_uk_gender_pay_gap, get_changes · Public sink: connect_account, request_api_key, claim_api_key, query_uk_charities, query_uk_company_profiles, query_uk_payment_practices, query_uk_gender_pay_gap

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
